title: EOPF Zarr product
description: Attributes of Sentinel products of the ESA Earth Observation Processing Framework (EOPF, https://cpm.pages.eopf.copernicus.eu/eopf-cpm/main/) in Zarr. Undeclared: recognised from the attributes. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes of the product root group or of one of its arrays.

stac_discovery.title: STAC discovery metadata
stac_discovery.description: A STAC Item describing the product, embedded in the product root group; its asset hrefs point into the Zarr hierarchy.

other_metadata.title: Other metadata
other_metadata.description: Product metadata not covered by the STAC Item, such as band descriptions and processing parameters.

processing_history.title: Processing history
processing_history.description: Processors, inputs and outputs of each processing level that led to the product.

_eopf_attrs.title: EOPF variable attributes
_eopf_attrs.description: Attributes of a variable as recorded by EOPF, such as its dimensions, data type, scaling and units, duplicating its CF-style attributes.
